comparison_basis: Freeze both live arms before generation; compare their deterministic joined intent/slots deliveries on historically exposed NEW500, and report OLD500/DEV1000, natural/equal-scenario weighting, speaker sensitivity, output failures, model contacts and actual full-stage cost. The direct phase is regenerated in each arm. Components based on sealed predecessors are descriptive references.
